checks.details: Requirement 1.1: All full-store subscription patterns (useStore()) have been replaced with selector-based access. useShallow is used for 3+ fields, individual selectors for 1-2 fields. No bare useStore() calls found in production code. 70+ locations annotated with 'zustand-selector-optimization' comments.
Requirement 1.2: Action functions are obtained via individual selectors (s => s.action) without useShallow, since actions don't trigger re-renders. Pattern consistently applied across all components.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/renderer/App.tsx:107-109 - loadRecentProjects, selectProject, checkSpecManagerFiles as individual selectors

checks.details: Requirement 1.3: All listed stores have been migrated. useSharedBugStore, useSpecStore, useProjectStore, useAgentStore, useSharedAgentStore, useNotificationStore, useRemoteAccessStore, useConnectionStore, useScheduleTaskStore, useWorkflowStore, useMcpStore, useToolPathStore, useEditorStore, useParallelModeStore, useMetricsStore - all use selector patterns.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/renderer/App.tsx - useProjectStore with useShallow, useSpecStore/useSharedBugStore with individual selectors

checks.details: Requirement 1.4: Remote UI components are also migrated with selector patterns. remote-ui/App.tsx LeftSidebar, RightSidebar, and FooterContent all use individual selectors for useSharedAgentStore. BugsView uses useShallow. BugDetailView and CreateBugDialogRemote use individual selectors.

Requirement 2.1: All 5 list item components are wrapped with React.memo. BugListItem, SpecListItem, AgentListItem, EventLogListItem, and ScheduleTaskListItem all export as React.memo wrapped components.

Requirement 2.2: Inline callbacks in .map() are eliminated via Wrapper components. BugListContainer uses BugListItemWrapper with useCallback. SpecListContainer uses SpecListItemWrapper. AgentList uses AgentListItemWrapper. ScheduleTaskSettingView uses ScheduleTaskListItemWrapper. All wrappers stabilize onSelect callbacks using useCallback.

Requirement 2.3: All props passed to memoized items are primitive values, stable references, or memoized objects. BugListItem receives bug (object from Zustand store with referential stability), isSelected (boolean), onSelect (stabilized via wrapper useCallback), runningAgentCount (number). Same pattern applies to other list items.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/shared/components/bug/BugListContainer.tsx:234-243 - BugListItemWrapper receives primitives and stable references
electron-sdd-manager/src/shared/components/spec/SpecListContainer.tsx:241-254 - SpecListItemWrapper receives primitives and stable references
electron-sdd-manager/src/shared/components/agent/AgentList.tsx:170-178 - AgentListItemWrapper receives primitives and stable references

checks.details: Requirement 4.1: useShallow is imported from 'zustand/react/shallow' consistently across all files that use it. 25 files import useShallow from this path, matching the Zustand v4.4+ official recommendation.

Requirement 4.2: useShallow usage criteria is applied consistently. Components with 3+ fields use useShallow (e.g., App.tsx, BugList, SpecList, AgentListPanel, ProjectAgentPanel). Components with 1-2 fields use individual selectors (e.g., ApprovalPanel, DocsTabs, NotificationProvider). Actions always use individual selectors.

Requirement 5.1: Test mocks have been updated to support selector patterns (multiple test files show zustand-selector-optimization mock helpers). However, we cannot verify that all unit tests pass without running them. Test mock patterns are updated in BugList.test, SpecList.test, AgentListPanel.test, DocsTabs.test, BugPane.test, CreateBugDialog.test, ProjectPane.test, McpSettingsPanel.test, BugActionButtons.test, ProjectFileEditor.test, DocsTabs.integration.test.

Requirement 5.2: E2E tests are not modified (expected for internal optimization). Cannot verify E2E pass status without running tests. The implementation is purely internal refactoring (selectors + React.memo) with no external behavior changes, so E2E tests should pass unchanged.

Requirement 5.3: TypeScript type check (tsc --noEmit) cannot be verified without running the command. The implementation uses proper TypeScript patterns with typed selectors and React.memo generic types. No obvious type errors in the code reviewed.
